what: Hydrological Station Catalogs and Time Series from Public APIs
title: Hydrological Station Catalogs and Time Series from Public APIs
text: hydrodownloadR provides unified, extensible interface discovering hydrological stations downloading daily time series (water discharge, water level, water temperature, flow velocity) national/regional public APIs. package uses provider registry identifiers (provider_id, provider_name) S3 generics stations() / timeseries(). supports complete histories (1900-01-01 today), per-station selection, rate limiting & retries, optional auth via environment variables, UTF-8 ASCII normalization, coordinate transformation WGS84. Built reproducible workflows easy addition new providers.
